purpose: Places worth looking when a question needs history, criticism, listener opinion or musical character. A suggestion list, not a restriction: read_page accepts any public URL.

sites.name: Lost Live Dead
sites.good_for: Deep, sourced histories of individual shows, venues, tours and the band's business; strongest on 1965-1975 and on how a show came to happen.
read_hints: Posts are long; use read_page with a focus phrase such as a date or venue.

sites.name: Hooterollin' Around
sites.good_for: Side projects, guests, the wider Bay Area scene, Garcia's and Lesh's other bands, gear and personnel questions.

sites.name: Grateful Dead Guide (Deadessays)
sites.good_for: Song-by-song and era-by-era musical analysis: how jams, arrangements and transitions developed, with dated examples.

sites.name: Dead Sources
sites.good_for: Transcribed contemporary press: reviews, interviews and news items from the years the shows happened.

sites.name: Grateful Seconds
sites.good_for: Statistics and lists: song counts, set placements, first and last performances, oddities and streaks.

sites.name: Deadhead High
sites.good_for: Listener-facing guides and listening paths: best first shows, how songs changed live, eras and lineups, AUD versus SBD.

search.notes: No site search; pages are matched by their URL slugs.

read_hints: Guides live under /guides/<slug>; song guides under /songs.

sites.name: Grateful Dead Archive Online
sites.good_for: Primary artifacts and fan recollections: posters, tickets, photographs, letters and first-person show accounts contributed to the UC Santa Cruz archive.

sites.name: Internet Archive Grateful Dead collection
sites.good_for: Recordings of nearly every show with listener reviews and star ratings. Use get_recording_reviews for a recording or show; use search_site for a date or free-text search of the collection.

sites.name: Dead.net
sites.good_for: Official song histories, the Greatest Stories Ever Told essays, Deadcast episode pages, interviews and features.

search.notes: Search is Google-powered in the browser and cannot be called. Use search_stored_resources, get_lore_source_trails and get_deadnet_song_context for URLs, then read_page.

read_hints: Comment threads on song and show pages are visitor recollections and are stripped by read_page; the essay body remains.

sites.name: Whitegum song and show finder
sites.good_for: Alex Allan's setlist and song databases, with per-song performance histories and per-show pages.

search.notes: Static site with no search; start from https://whitegum.com/intro.htm and follow links with read_page.

sites.name: HeadyVersion
sites.good_for: Fan votes on the best versions of each song.

search.notes: The site refuses automated readers; treat it as a link to offer, not a page to read.
